schema.description: This schema contains the structure of data for search engine icons which built from search-engine-config-v2. The associated remote settings collection is search-config-icons.

engineIdentifierPrefixes.description: An array of search engine identifier prefixes that the attached icon is for. This is in addition to the list in engineIdentifiers.
engineIdentifierPrefixes.title: Engine Identifier Prefixes

engineIdentifiers.description: An array of search engine identifiers that the attached icon is for. This is in addition to the list in engineIdentifierPrefixes.
engineIdentifiers.title: Engine Identifiers

imageSize.description: The image size in pixels. May be used to choose the most appropriate image for the display.
imageSize.title: Image Size

schema.title: Search Engine Icons Schema
